checks.label: A one-line diagram outlines the connections from the power sources (generators, shore power, battery banks) through the switchboard and busbars to the loads: here two generator sets, a shore supply and a battery feed the board, and each of the 7 loads has a path to a source

A one line starts at the top with the incoming power and its disconnecting device, then works its way down: the sets and the shore supply sit above their breakers, the breakers above the busbars, and every load lower still

Counted by hand: the drawing shows 4 sources (3 at the top, 2 sets, 5 counting -T1 and -U1); opening -Q12 takes off 2 loads (slips 0, 1 and 4), leaving 5 of 7; -Q2 tripping takes off 1 (slips 3, 4 and 2), leaving 6; the typed fields ask exactly these

Power passes on down through -T1 and -U1, never back up: with -Q22 open, battery -G3 keeps the DC board live while the charger's input stays dead; with -Q12 open the 115 V board is dead and section A stays live

Closing -Q4 as drawn would join -G1 and -G2, so the synchronise card comes up and -Q4 stays open; with -Q2 open it closes and -G1 feeds section B; -Q23 cannot close while -Q13 is closed; -Q5 and -Q22 close freely
On shore supply with both sets stopped, -Q4 closes without synchronising and the shore supply then feeds section A, so -M1 is fed through the bus-tie
Isolating -M3: -Q13 alone leaves -Q23 free to close from -G2; -Q13 and -Q23 isolate it with no other load taken off; -Q1 and -Q2 leave the shore supply a way in through -Q3 and take off 4 other loads
Isolating -A3: -Q22 alone leaves it live from battery -G3; -Q22 and -Q5 isolate it but take off -E3; -F4 alone isolates it and keeps -E3 lit
Before an answer nothing gives it away: every puzzle opens on its own board with nothing locked and no card, and both typed screens' readouts show ?
Every demonstration settles within 4.5 s of its screen opening, and every answer's motion within 2.5 s
